kind: retrospective reaggregation of previously inspected saved results, not prospective preregistration
population: 2665 joined Estonia LUCAS2018 woodland sites, fixed WorldCover2021 tree-cover predictions and original support; no new masks
estimand: fixed census least-squares coefficients; east_per100km and north_per100km
covariance: saved covariance (complete inclusion derivative); not jackknife
coverage: nominal 95%, scipy norm.ppf(.975); finite error and finite positive marginal variance; failed/undefined intervals count as noncoverage; no dropped attempts
paired_mcse: 100*sd(I_T-I_C,ddof=1)/sqrt(B), pairing by scenario,budget,row index of shared labels, separate prediction/coordinate; not field-cluster
width: mean among valid marginal intervals; report count
rmse: sqrt(mean(error^2)) among finite estimates; report count and not impute failed estimates
gap: saved method-specific gap, never finite-sample bias
oracle: saved oracle_covariance only; report gap/sqrt(Vjj) and mean Vhat/Vjj over valid intervals; missing if invalid
checks: match saved summaries and paired summaries; sizes=labels.sum; original stage11 labels equal; pi=(n/N)*normalized intensity; X in map7; uniform gap zero; gap budget invariance
new_randomness: none; no simulation or refitting; inherited seeds unchanged
output: worldcover18rows, f0 18rows, pairing audit, report, manifests, QA, environment and run log
